userInputText: Five Nights at Freddy's: Sister Location is a horror survival game where players take on the role of a technician who must work at Circus Baby's Pizza World, a new location featuring animatronic characters.Unlike the previous games in the series, Sister Location introduces a more narrative-driven experience with a focus on exploration. Players navigate through various rooms and perform tasks while trying to avoid being attacked by the animatronics.
